$10,854.00 - $13,493.00 per Month
  
New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable.

**Final Filing Date:** **11/4/2026**

Electronic (Using your CalCareer Account)

By Mail

Print Job

### **Job Description and Duties**

As Manager of Environmental Support Unit B, supervise five Environmental Scientists that provide environmental and cultural regulatory compliance on flood maintenance and project activities. Provide planning, coordination, environmental review and permitting services associated with the operations, maintenance, repair, replacement, rehabilitation and improvement of Sacramento River Flood Control Project and other State Plan of Flood Control facilities; work with staff and agency representatives in carrying out DWR studies, central valley flood protection planning, project implementation, and planning commitments. Perform site visits to assess project impacts. Provide support for State emergency response actions.

You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**.

### **Department Information**

**Division of Flood Operations, Flood Maintenance and Operations Branch, Environmental Support Section, Environmental Support Unit B, Sacramento**

Department of Water Resources (DWR) was established in 1956 by the California State Legislature. We manage California’s water resources, systems, and infrastructure, including the State Water Project, in a responsible sustainable way.

At DWR, we are embedding climate change response into every project we undertake. We have set standards to help evaluate how each project incorporates climate resilience principles and ensure consistency across the Department. Our mission is to sustainably manage the water resources of California, in cooperation with other agencies, to benefit the state’s people and protect, restore, and enhance the natural and human environments.

DWR also strives to create a trusting and welcoming workplace where employees embrace diverse viewpoints and treat each other with civility and respect. An important component of DWR’s equal employment opportunity program centers around justice, equity, diversity, and inclusion.

Department Website: https://water.ca.gov/

Free virtual career consultation services including one-on-one DWR career consultations, application/resume review, tips for applying, and mock interviews, provided by DWR’s Recruitment and Workforce Planning section can now be scheduled via https://water.ca.gov/About/Careers.

  

### **Special Requirements**

Possession of a valid California driver's license. Infrequent travel may be required. May be required to work evenings, nights, weekends, or holidays during flood emergencies or emergencies for which OES tasks the Department to assist.

jobs.title: Water Resources Specialist
jobs.description:
Westlands Water District is seeking a talented and analytical Water Resources Specialist to help address some of the most complex and impactful water resource challenges facing California today.

This is an exceptional opportunity to play a key role in long-term water supply planning, groundwater management, environmental compliance, and strategic resource initiatives that directly support one of the nation's largest agricultural water districts.

#### **Salary****:**

* **Annual Salary Range:** $100,008 - $200,016.
* **Anticipated Hiring Range:** $100,008 - $150,000 DOQ (Depending on Qualifications).

#### **Location:**

Fresno or Sacramento, California.

#### **Why Join Westlands?**

**As a Water Resources Specialist, you'll work on high-profile projects involving:**

* Central Valley Project (CVP) and State Water Project (SWP) operations.
* Groundwater management and water supply reliability.
* Environmental compliance and permitting.
* Water policy, economic, and technical analyses.
* Hydrologic and operational forecasting.
* Strategic planning and stakeholder coordination.

The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver who can translate complex technical and regulatory information into practical recommendations that support critical water management decisions.

#### **Minimum Qualifications:**

Bachelor's degree in Water Resources, Hydrology, Geology, Hydrogeology, Environmental Science, Engineering, Agricultural Science, Public Policy, Economics, Natural Resource Management, or a closely related field, plus three years of professional experience in water resources or a related discipline. A master's degree may substitute for two years of experience.

#### **Outstanding Benefits:**

**Westlands Water District offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes:**

* CalPERS Retirement.
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance.
* Life and Disability Insurance.
* Education Assistance.
* 457 Deferred Compensation Plan.
* Paid Vacation and Holidays.
* Flexible Spending Account.
* Employee Assistance Program.
* Longevity Pay and more.

#### **Application Deadline:**

**Open Until Filled**. Applications are being accepted beginning October 21, 2026.

##### **IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS!**

To receive consideration for this position, **interested applicants must submit a completed Employment Application through the District's website at** **https://wwd.ca.gov/about-westlands/human-resources/****.**

  

Applications submitted through third-party career platforms will not be accepted as a substitute for the District's required application process. Applicants may attach a resume; however, **resumes will not be considered in lieu of a completed Employment Application.**

For complete position details and to apply, visit the District's website: **https://wwd.ca.gov/about-westlands/human-resources/.**

jobs.title: Environmental Scientist Consultant - January Start
jobs.description:
**About Us**
============

At Onterris, we build careers grounded in purpose, responsibility and real-world impact.

“For Planet and Progress” is our north star that guides everything we do. We believe environmental responsibility and human progress are interconnected, interwoven and international. Our scientists, engineers, field teams, consultants and professionals collaborate across disciplines and geographies, guiding industries and governments, ensuring that communities and environments thrive.

When you join us, you’re not just forging a career, you’re joining a movement. A movement for better thinking, smarter solutions and lasting impact.

Together, we will advance our way of life and protect the integrity of our environment every step of the way.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

Formerly known as Epic Environmental, the Australian arm of Onterris has kept the strong culture we are well known for. The team continues to work closely with clients, building trusted relationships and delivering high-quality outcomes without an overemphasis on KPIs.

Our teams have the opportunity to work alongside industry leaders, auditors, and professionals with vast experience within our industry, while enjoying regular social events and collaborative work that bring the team together. Onterris also supports career development through relevant internal opportunities and individual one-on-one career conversations focused on growth and progression.

We are seeking a Consultant Environmental Scientist to join our growing Contaminated Land and Water team out of our Sydney office. Have the opportunity to work alongside more than 50 land and water professionals across Australia who are actively invested in mentoring, collaboration and your long-term career development.

This role will be responsible for a full range of activities including:

* Planning and delivering field investigations across a variety of sites – including soil, groundwater, and surface water assessments

* Preparing clear and high-quality reports

* Acting as the representative/client contact on site for Onterris

* Attending business development meetings

Supporting project managers and ensuring open and clear communications when in the field  



**Your Expertise and Skills**
=============================

These requirements reflect the knowledge, skills and abilities that help you do your best work here.

* 1-3 years consulting experience in contaminated land

* Tertiary qualifications in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Environmental Management or related disciplines

* Solid understanding of NSW and national environmental frameworks

* Confidence in the field and an eye for detail and technical excellence

* Open C class drivers licence valid in NSW

Onterris is a leading global environmental solutions company partnering with organizations to solve complex challenges where environmental pressures, regulatory expectations and operational risks intersect. Guided by our mission to advance the way of life without compromising the integrity of our environment, we believe environmental responsibility and human progress are fundamentally connected. Our scientists, engineers, field teams and consultants apply systems thinking that unites science, data and practical expertise to deliver solutions that strengthen our clients’ resilience, mitigate risk and protect the air, water and soil that sustain communities, while uncovering responsible paths forward for planet and progress. For more information, visit www.onterris.com .

We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. We acknowledge that these experiences and perspectives help to enrich our teams and contribute to our ongoing success. We are committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in our employment for all applicants. For US residents, click here to learn more.
